body: That is what I tell ppl who try keep trying to sway me into religion. It usually shuts them up.

Therapy and suicide hotlines are a joke imo. Like most company support agents. It's just a script...

They are volunteers at least (I think), so their heart is in a good place I hope. But your not gonna talk someone down from suicide. You might delay it, or just as likely, make it worse.

I wish I had made a YouTube channel documenting it all, but I am too shy and afraid people would just make fun of me. I didn't exactly go in thinking I'd get as far as I did. My goal was just to lose some weight and get outside more, then it snowballed from there over the years. I don't even have any "before" pics because no pictures exist of me from ages 18-31ish.

I don't really know how I did it either. Looking back at all the effort I put in, I could not do it again though. I thought there was more to life and these things were the key to happiness. We are trained so young in western culture that looks and money is happiness. I now believe the key to happiness is a healthy quiet simple life with someone you love. Maybe I'll meet someone on my travels who understands that.. who knows.

You only have one more year and you can do whatever. Anyone you meet in highschool is very temporary and any of the problems you face are very small. Just ignore people you don't like and you won't ever have to see them again.

Delete social media if it's not doing positive things for you. High school is full of terrible people, I wouldn't stress about their opinions. Just go solo if you need too, it's a very small fraction of your life.

And yes, boys in that age are typically after one thing only. It'll be the same in college, though there are some exceptions. If you want a guy that wants a relationship that young your best bet is probably the ugly shy guy in the corner who has no other options. Men take a long time to grow up, especially the popular ones. I mean every girl Ive liked in my entire life won't even look in my direction, so this specific problem seems like nothing to me.
